summary: Tenable Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing the closing of its private offering of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including the full exercise of the $75 million initial purchasers' over-allotment option. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, and bear interest at 0.25% per year, payable semiannually starting March 15, 2027. The offering represents a capital markets transaction rather than a special situation, though the issuance of convertible notes carries potential equity dilution implications. Holders may convert under specified conditions, including a 150% stock price trigger over a 30-day trading period or upon certain corporate events. Investors should watch for the use of proceeds and any related capped call or conversion rate mechanics disclosed in the full filing, as these will affect the effective conversion premium and dilution profile. The conversion price, initial conversion rate, and any associated hedge transactions were not specified in the excerpt.
